issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מַלְאָכֵכֵה' (your messengers/angels) is translated as '你的天使' (your angels), which is acceptable, but the phrase 'קוֹל מַלְאָכֵכֵה' means 'the voice of your messengers' — the Chinese '你的天使的聲' is correct. However, the Hebrew 'רִכְבָּהּ' (her chariots) is translated as '你的戰車' (your chariots), changing the possessive from third-person feminine singular (her) to second-person (your). This is a person/grammatical error that alters who the chariots belong to.
